instructions:
This is a corrected successor to incomplete SOL-006, NOT a retry of the HY3 experiment. SOL-006 stopped at the model usage limit. Its exact commit f193742daab0f55c166b9b084bd288151c1e764d preserves a 595-line unfinished verifier, task-lock.json and a seven-test passing scheduler log. Those files are unaccepted drafts/evidence, not a successful review. Fetch that existing branch only if needed, hash its exact canonical blobs, inspect them, then reuse suitable code under audit/SOL-008 with provenance instead of rebuilding from scratch. Preserve the original attempt untouched. Explicitly adapt task identity, paths and saved verification bindings to this immutable task. The historical task-lock/source SHA remains historical evidence, not permission to pretend SOL-006 completed. Do not edit the old task or use the worker branch as the new base.

The production numerical source and scheduler code have not changed: verify byte equality at this new pushed base against the original pinned commits. Reuse the seven-test protocol log only after exact source/log verification; finish the independent scheduler transition probes and narrative. Do not repeat that suite merely to change the task number. Complete numerical recomputation, corruption tests, missing findings/review/scheduler-review/verification outputs, initializer and read-only replay. If the partial verifier contains errors, fix them only in this assigned audit directory and retain failure diagnoses. A genuine negative audited finding is useful; clearly separate review completion from whether the reviewed target is approved.

Keep model I/O concise: read only needed sections and print counts/residual summaries instead of whole CSVs or repetitive metadata. No unexplained PASS claims. If quota is still unavailable, preserve the new failure; do not substitute another model or open another worker.

Original substantive review requirements (all current outputs belong to audit/SOL-008):

Read AGENTS.md and the immutable task plus locked contracts. This is the required independent review of HY3-003 at exactly 7652410d73425371110784ef5fa97c03470a074e, NOT a request to regenerate the baseline experiment. The result is not yet accepted and is absent from main. Read binary git show of the exact commit, fetching its existing work/hy3/HY3-003-a1 branch only if necessary. The pinned main source already contains all accepted production code. Do not merge or mutate another branch. Verify every source/artifact hash and execution log before interpreting results. The HY3 run uses ec9653f1a4739bf1f0db36092c64771d014df25e and original development hash 9c4ad83f5dda86251a754e126528a71dd930ae88ed7cdb8a0663a327b6bfb7c7. Distinguish canonical Git bytes from allowed CRLF source checkouts. The manifest records a normalized python command, while the runner receipt records the executable and -B; verify their semantic agreement.

Write independent standard-library scalar arithmetic rather than importing production accounting/metrics/experiments for the expected answers. Check all required row counts, unique complete sorted keys and units. Derive selected forward paths from only the development CSV. Recompute all metrics from saved validated ledgers and all summaries/pairs; add all severe IDs to the representative set. Check exact tie location selection on saved float observations separately from numerically tolerant scalar forward paths. Check initial fee, inflation-only purchasing-power loss and post-fee trough behavior explicitly. Record worst residuals, checks actually run and expected/observed facts. A production saved --check may be used once as secondary evidence, never as the independent oracle, and must not alter source or saved results. Avoid rerunning the 59-test historical suite or HY3 production command; focused synthetic timing checks suffice.

Perform a small separate review of chief commit 10b3ff29f72b01d6a1a1bd2ca174f8cd6c7840d4 relative to its parent, scoped to scripts/coop.py and tests/test_coop.py. Confirm results arriving during a turn remain pending, legacy checkpoints recover once, failed/dirty turns do not acknowledge pending work, and unchanged snapshots idle. Verify and reuse the preserved seven-test suite log when the exact source is unchanged; complete independent focused probes. Add focused probes under audit/SOL-008 only if a missing case materially affects the verdict. Do not run a live watcher, publish status, alter locks/checkpoints, or edit scripts/coop.py. Report this independent scheduler verdict separately, so an unrelated finding does not invalidate good numerical evidence.

Produce review.md, findings.json with separate numerical/scheduler verdicts and blockers, verification.json binding exact commits/hashes and deterministic evidence, scheduler-review.json, and portable verify.py. Initializer writes evidence only if absent; --check recomputes and compares read-only and exits nonzero on mismatch. Keep scratch only inside ignored .runtime or this assigned audit directory. Preserve every failed trial/negative probe distinctly. No main/queue/task/config/source modification, no installs, no private team data, no final outcomes, no policy fitting. Include limits: three predeclared static references, original synthetic annual returns, development-only descriptive evidence, no significance or investability conclusion. Runner handles handoff and commit/push.
